intent: Move package intent/approval, tool provisioning intent/denylist/profile, and notification delivery-log reads to authoritative, signed, bounded, confidential kind-30900 state.
source_of_truth: service-authored 30900 addressable events with the five 32030-32034 legacy_kind discriminators and single-letter t topics
security: All five families are encrypted under the fleet OCK before publication; relay read auth exposes only ciphertext. Package approval claims remain authoritative in the local single-use admission store.
boundedness: Each canonical plaintext is at most 60 KiB. Notification logs are one replaceable latest-50 record per channel with payload/error truncation and oldest-first eviction under the byte budget.
